def inside(x,y,poly):
 # strict interior, also edge false
 inside=False
 for i,(x1,y1) in enumerate(poly):
  x2,y2=poly[(i+1)%len(poly)]
  # on segment
  cr=(x-x1)*(y2-y1)-(y-y1)*(x2-x1)
  if abs(cr)<1e-9 and min(x1,x2)<=x<=max(x1,x2) and min(y1,y2)<=y<=max(y1,y2): return False
  if (y1>y)!=(y2>y):
   xx=x1+(y-y1)*(x2-x1)/(y2-y1)
   if x<xx: inside=not inside
 return inside
